newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends up 60 cents in seasonal charge.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends up 60 cents in seasonal charge.

text.p: IPE November Brent closed 60 cents up at $20.30 a barrel, setting a new intra-day high in the last hour of trade and brokers said good demand for distillates on both sides of the Atlantic propelled crude higher.

November Brent opened stronger on Wednesday morning after U.S. weekly stocks data by the American Petroleum Institute (API) showed a lower than expected build in distillate stocks for this time of year.
